description: HydPy is a Python platform for developing and applying hydrological models, maintained by Bjoernsen Consulting Engineers after development at Ruhr University Bochum and the German Federal Institute of Hydrology. It contains model-development facilities, scripting interfaces and automatic Cython translation of Python model cores. Model-specific inputs and outputs support experiments such as runoff forecasting in large river basins. Geographic extent, time steps and study horizon depend on the implemented model and its data. Source is free under LGPL-3.0, with online documentation and examples. A limitation is that the platform has no graphical interface and requires hydrological knowledge and programming skills. Its multi-threading and compilation facilities do not remove uncertainty in model structure or calibration. HydPy supports water-resource and flood-defence simulations. pywatershed (platform-pywatershed) provides a related modular hydrology platform. This review inspected documentation only and did not run its automatic tests or forecasts.
name: HydPy hydrological modelling platform
